decisions.reason: The medical examination light builds on the firm's LED and professional lighting know-how, and its own R&D lets it refine the product, though as a niche outside its core building segments it carries some withdrawal risk.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires draw directly on the firm's certified manufacturing, testing facilities and industrial customer knowledge, so the firm can absorb feedback and keep improving the line.
As a relaunch of a popular designer task light close to the core offer, the firm has deep prior knowledge and market feedback, although single designer items are refreshed fairly often.
The pendant office luminaire sits squarely within the firm's established office lighting expertise, so it is easy to interpret its results and upgrade it with advancing LED technology.
The premium pendant line of several models is close to the core offer and draws on the firm's engineering and LED knowledge, which supports continued development rather than withdrawal.
